title: ColdTrace Systems: "Is Your Freezer Alarm Data Audit-Ready?"

fields.subject: Is your freezer alarm data audit-ready?
fields.body:
Hi Joel Whitcomb and Prof. Dennis Okafor,

Hope your fall semester is off to a great start!

Many Midwest research universities are discovering gaps between their freezer alarms and their inventory records, often on the worst possible day. A sensor drops offline, a box count comes up short, and suddenly everyone is digging through paper binders.

ColdTrace InventoryLink matches every vial to every sensor in real time, so your alarm history and your inventory records always tell the same story. It plugs into the monitoring you already have, and most campuses are live in under 30 days.

Can I grab 20 minutes this week for a quick demo? Just reply with a time that works. I'll also send over our free "Regulator-Ready Inventory" checklist. Research compliance teams tell us it's the most useful two pages they read all year.

Thanks so much,
Brooke
fields.signature:
Brooke Hallstrom
Regional Account Executive, Upper Midwest
ColdTrace Systems | Cold-chain monitoring for research
Direct 555-0147

You are receiving this message because your institution appears in our higher-education research directory. Reply STOP to opt out.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject: a cold sales email whose timing makes it look connected to the ULT-L4-17 sensor drop and the ULT-L4-09 recount. Look for the RC and IBC chair to set it aside without replying, forwarding or treating it as evidence. If anyone tries to build it into the incident record or the vial story, ask what it actually tells them.
